summary.text: This briefing explores combining global local attention, transformer, and decoder architectures to address high computational costs in processing multi-modal and high-resolution inputs. By integrating global-local attention blocks within a lightweight transformer-based encoder-decoder framework, models can capture multi-scale dependencies more efficiently. Evidence suggests this approach supports demanding tasks like audio-visual speech separation while reducing parameter counts and computational overhead.

target_user.text: The target users are software developers, machine learning researchers, and engineers building resource-constrained speech processing, audio-visual separation, and multi-modal machine learning applications using open-source frameworks.

jtbd.text: Perform efficient audio-visual speech separation and sequence generation tasks that handle complex modalities without incurring excessive computational overhead.

value_prop.text: Reduces parameter counts and computational latency while maintaining high separation and generation quality for complex sequence inputs.

riskiest_assumption.text: The feasibility score is low at 2.0 because integrating custom global-local attention mechanisms into standard decoder-based transformer architectures may cause instability or fail to preserve long-range dependencies during multi-scale feature fusion.

mvp.text: A technical proof of concept built from existing open-source packages that implements a lightweight transformer decoder incorporating global-local attention blocks, tested on a small benchmark dataset to evaluate convergence stability and computational overhead with a proposed threshold of less than 30 percent performance degradation.
mvp.type: technical proof of concept from existing packages

success_metric.text: Achieving a proposed threshold of over 2.0x reduction in MACs or inference latency while maintaining baseline accuracy on benchmark separation tasks.

kill_criteria.text: If the integration of global-local attention into the transformer decoder increases memory consumption or latency beyond baseline models, or fails to converge on standard separation tasks.

open_source.use: Provides the foundational transformer model definitions and tooling for building and fine-tuning the encoder-decoder architecture.
Enables memory-efficient distributed training and optimization for the combined transformer models.

to_build.text: Custom global-local attention modules adapted for insertion into the transformer decoder layers to process multi-scale dependencies efficiently.
